(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ===== HEADER SCROLL =====
  const header = document.getElementById('header');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    const curr = window.scrollY;
    if (curr > 40) {
      header.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
      header.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
    lastScroll = curr;
  }, { passive: true });

  // ===== MOBILE MENU =====
  const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
  mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
  });
  mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
    });
  });

  // ===== CAROUSEL =====
  const track = document.getElementById('carouselInner');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();

  function getCardsPerView() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w < 480) return 1;
    if (w < 768) return 2;
    if (w < 1024) return 3;
    return 4;
  }

  function getTotalPages() {
    return Math.max(1, cards.length - cardsPerView + 1);
  }

  function buildDots() {
    dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const pages = Math.ceil(cards.length / cardsPerView);
    for (let i = 0; i < pages; i++) {
      const dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === Math.floor(currentIndex / cardsPerView) ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to page ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        currentIndex = i * cardsPerView;
        if (currentIndex > cards.length - cardsPerView) currentIndex = cards.length - cardsPerView;
        updateCarousel();
      });
      dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }

  function updateCarousel() {
    const gap = 24;
    const card = cards[0];
    const cardWidth = card.offsetWidth + gap;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-currentIndex * cardWidth) + 'px)';
    prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= cards.length - cardsPerView;
    const pages = Math.ceil(cards.length / cardsPerView);
    const activePage = Math.floor(currentIndex / cardsPerView);
    dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach(function(d, i) {
      d.classList.toggle('active', i === activePage);
    });
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      currentIndex--;
      updateCarousel();
    }
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (currentIndex < cards.length - cardsPerView) {
      currentIndex++;
      updateCarousel();
    }
  });

  // Touch/swipe
  let startX = 0;
  let isDragging = false;
  const trackEl = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
  trackEl.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    isDragging = true;
  }, { passive: true });
  trackEl.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    isDragging = false;
    const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      if (diff > 0 && currentIndex < cards.length - cardsPerView) {
        currentIndex++;
      } else if (diff < 0 && currentIndex > 0) {
        currentIndex--;
      }
      updateCarousel();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
    if (currentIndex > cards.length - cardsPerView) {
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - cardsPerView);
    }
    buildDots();
    updateCarousel();
  });

  buildDots();
  updateCarousel();

  // ===== STORE LOCATOR =====
  const zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');
  const searchBtn = document.getElementById('storeSearchBtn');
  const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');

  function doStoreSearch() {
    var val = zipInput.value.trim();
    if (val.length > 0) {
      storeResults.classList.add('show');
      storeResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }
  }

  searchBtn.addEventListener('click', doStoreSearch);
  zipInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      doStoreSearch();
    }
  });

  // ===== NEWSLETTER =====
  var newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
  var newsletterConfirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');
  newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    newsletterForm.style.display = 'none';
    newsletterConfirm.classList.add('show');
  });

  // ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
  var animItems = document.querySelectorAll('.animate-on-scroll');
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {
    threshold: 0.1,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px'
  });
  animItems.forEach(function(item) {
    observer.observe(item);
  });

  // Stagger animations for grid children
  document.querySelectorAll('.seasonal-grid .animate-on-scroll, .categories-grid .animate-on-scroll, .stats-grid .animate-on-scroll').forEach(function(item, i) {
    item.style.transitionDelay = (i * 0.1) + 's';
  });

  // ===== KEYBOARD ACCESSIBILITY FOR CATEGORIES =====
  document.querySelectorAll('.category-card').forEach(function(card) {
    card.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        card.click();
      }
    });
  });

})();
</script>

</html>

  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.3);
}
.btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.4);
}
.btn-secondary {
  background: white;
  color: var(--green);
  border: 2px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.15);
}
.btn-secondary:hover {
  border-color: var(--green);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.hero-visual {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.hero-image-card {
  width: 420px;
  height: 460px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a8d5ba 0%, #d4e6b5 40%, #f7d794 100%);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  animation: scaleIn 1s ease forwards 0.2s;
  opacity: 0;
}
.hero-image-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 50%, rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.1));
}
.hero-emoji-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  font-size: 52px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.hero-emoji-grid span {
  animation: float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.9s; }
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 1.2s; }
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 1.5s; }
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 1.8s; }
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 2.1s; }
.hero-emoji-grid span:nth-child(9) { animation-delay: 2.4s; }

.hero-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 60px;
  padding: 80px 0;
}

/* Floating tag on hero image */
.hero-float-tag {
  position: absolute;
  background: white;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 12px 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--green-dark);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 2;
  animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.hero-float-tag-1 { bottom: 40px; left: -30px; animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.hero-float-tag-2 { top: 30px; right: -30px; animation-delay: 1.5s; }

/* ===== SECTION COMMON ===== */
.section {
  padding: 100px 0;
}
.section-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 56px;
}
.section-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  color: var(--green);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.section-title {
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.section-subtitle {
  font-size: 17px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  max-width: 560px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* ===== FEATURED PRODUCTS CAROUSEL ===== */
.products-section {
  background: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.carousel-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0 20px;
}
.carousel-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}
.carousel-track-inner {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
  transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.product-card {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 260px;
  background: var(--cream);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  border: 1px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.06);
}
.product-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  border-color: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12);
}
.product-image {
  height: 200px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 72px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.product-image::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 40px;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--cream), transparent);
}
.product-info {
  padding: 20px;
}
.product-name {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-dark);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.product-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.product-price-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.product-price {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 22px;
  color: var(--green);
}
.product-add-btn {
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--green);
  color: white;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  transition: var(--transition);
  border: none;
}
.product-add-btn:hover {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

/* Carousel navigation */
.carousel-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 40px;
}
.carousel-btn {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: white;
  border: 2px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12);
  color: var(--green);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.carousel-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--green);
  color: white;
  border-color: var(--green);
  transform: scale(1.08);
}
.carousel-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.35;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.carousel-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}
.carousel-dot {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--green-muted);
  border: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  padding: 0;
}
.carousel-dot.active {
  background: var(--green);
  width: 28px;
  border-radius: 5px;
}

/* ===== SEASONAL PICKS ===== */
.seasonal-section {
  background: linear-gradient(170deg, #fff8e1 0%, var(--cream) 50%, #e8f5e9 100%);
}
.seasonal-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
  gap: 24px;
}
.seasonal-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 28px;
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  border: 1px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.06);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.seasonal-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange), var(--orange-dark));
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
  transform-origin: left;
}
.seasonal-card:hover::before { transform: scaleX(1); }
.seasonal-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.seasonal-emoji {
  font-size: 48px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.seasonal-name {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.seasonal-desc {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.seasonal-price {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 20px;
  color: var(--orange-dark);
}
.seasonal-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  background: rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.12);
  color: var(--orange-dark);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}

/* ===== CATEGORIES ===== */
.categories-section {
  background: var(--white);
}
.categories-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}
.category-card {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 3/4;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.category-card:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}
.category-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 64px;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}
.category-card:hover .category-bg {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}
.category-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 24px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.category-overlay::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.85), rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.1) 60%, transparent);
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.category-card:hover .category-overlay::before {
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.92), rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.3) 70%, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.1));
}
.category-name {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: white;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.category-desc {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(10px);
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.category-card:hover .category-desc {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ===== BRAND HIGHLIGHTS / STATS ===== */
.stats-section {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 72px 0;
}
.stats-section::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-dark) 0%, var(--green) 50%, var(--green-dark) 100%);
  opacity: 0.9;
}
.stats-pattern {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 24px 24px;
}
.stats-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 40px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.stat-item {
  text-align: center;
}
.stat-number {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 52px);
  color: white;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.stat-number span {
  color: var(--orange-light);
}
.stat-label {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.stat-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ===== STORE LOCATOR ===== */
.locator-section {
  background: linear-gradient(170deg, #e8f5e9 0%, var(--cream) 100%);
}
.locator-card {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: white;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 48px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.locator-input-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.locator-input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 16px;
  outline: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  background: var(--cream);
}
.locator-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
}
.locator-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
.locator-search-btn {
  padding: 16px 32px;
  background: var(--green);
  color: white;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.locator-search-btn:hover {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.locator-search-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

/* Store results */
.store-results {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.store-results.show { display: block; }
.store-results-title {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.store-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: 1px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  transition: var(--transition);
  background: var(--cream);
}
.store-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.store-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 22px;
}
.store-details {
  flex: 1;
}
.store-name {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-dark);
}
.store-address {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.store-hours {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--green);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.store-distance {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--green);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ===== NEWSLETTER ===== */
.newsletter-section {
  background: var(--white);
}
.newsletter-card {
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9 0%, #fff8e1 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 56px 48px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.newsletter-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 20px 20px;
}
.newsletter-emoji {
  font-size: 56px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}
.newsletter-title {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.newsletter-subtitle {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  max-width: 440px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.newsletter-form {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  max-width: 440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.newsletter-input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 15px;
  outline: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  background: white;
}
.newsletter-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
}
.newsletter-submit {
  padding: 16px 28px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: white;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.newsletter-submit:hover {
  background: var(--orange-dark);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.newsletter-confirm {
  display: none;
  position: relative;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--green);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.newsletter-confirm.show {
  display: flex;
}

/* ===== FOOTER ===== */
.footer {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  padding: 72px 0 32px;
}
.footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5fr repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}
.footer-brand {
  max-width: 260px;
}
.footer-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 22px;
  color: white;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.footer-logo-icon {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
}
.footer-tagline {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.footer-col-title {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: white;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.footer-col a {
  display: block;
  font-size: 14px;
  padding: 5px 0;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.footer-col a:hover {
  color: white;
  transform: translateX(4px);
}
.footer-bottom {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  padding-top: 28px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.footer-social {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}
.footer-social-link {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: var(--transition);
  font-size: 16px;
}
.footer-social-link:hover {
  background: var(--orange);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .hero-inner {
    flex-direction: column;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 60px 0;
  }
  .hero-content { max-width: 100%; }
  .hero-subtitle { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
  .hero-ctas { justify-content: center; }
  .hero-image-card { width: 320px; height: 340px; }
  .hero-emoji-grid { font-size: 40px; }
  .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 32px; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .section { padding: 72px 0; }
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }
  .hero-inner { gap: 40px; padding: 40px 0; }
  .hero-image-card { width: 280px; height: 300px; }
  .hero-float-tag { display: none; }
  .product-card { width: 220px; }
  .product-image { height: 160px; font-size: 56px; }
  .seasonal-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .stats-section { padding: 56px 0; }
  .locator-card { padding: 32px 24px; }
  .locator-input-row { flex-direction: column; }
  .newsletter-card { padding: 40px 24px; }
  .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
  .footer-brand { max-width: 100%; grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; text-align: center; }
  .store-item { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; gap: 12px; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .container { padding: 0 16px; }
  .section { padding: 56px 0; }
  .hero-image-card { width: 240px; height: 260px; }
  .hero-emoji-grid { font-size: 32px; gap: 14px; }
  .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* ===== CATEGORY BG COLORS ===== */
.cat-snacks { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e0, #ffe0b2); }
.cat-produce { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9, #c8e6c9); }
.cat-frozen { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }
.cat-beverages { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4ec, #f8bbd0); }
.cat-dairy { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fffde7, #fff9c4); }

/* ===== PRODUCT BG COLORS ===== */
.prod-granola { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1, #ffecb3); }

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ===== HEADER SCROLL =====
  const header = document.getElementById('header');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    const curr = window.scrollY;
    if (curr > 40) {
      header.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
      header.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
    lastScroll = curr;
  }, { passive: true });

  // ===== MOBILE MENU =====
  const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
  mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
  });
  mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
    });
  });

  // ===== CAROUSEL =====
  const track = document.getElementById('carouselInner');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();

  function getCardsPerView() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w < 480) return 1;
    if (w < 768) return 2;
    if (w < 1024) return 3;
    return 4;
  }

  function getTotalPages() {
    return Math.max(1, cards.length - cardsPerView + 1);
  }

  function buildDots() {
    dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const pages = Math.ceil(cards.length / cardsPerView);
    for (let i = 0; i < pages; i++) {
      const dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === Math.floor(currentIndex / cardsPerView) ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to page ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        currentIndex = i * cardsPerView;
        if (currentIndex > cards.length - cardsPerView) currentIndex = cards.length - cardsPerView;
        updateCarousel();
      });
      dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }

  function updateCarousel() {
    const gap = 24;
    const card = cards[0];
    const cardWidth = card.offsetWidth + gap;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-currentIndex * cardWidth) + 'px)';
    prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= cards.length - cardsPerView;
    const pages = Math.ceil(cards.length / cardsPerView);
    const activePage = Math.floor(currentIndex / cardsPerView);
    dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach(function(d, i) {
      d.classList.toggle('active', i === activePage);
    });
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      currentIndex--;
      updateCarousel();
    }
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (currentIndex < cards.length - cardsPerView) {
      currentIndex++;
      updateCarousel();
    }
  });

  // Touch/swipe
  let startX = 0;
  let isDragging = false;
  const trackEl = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
  trackEl.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    isDragging = true;
  }, { passive: true });
  trackEl.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    isDragging = false;
    const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      if (diff > 0 && currentIndex < cards.length - cardsPerView) {
        currentIndex++;
      } else if (diff < 0 && currentIndex > 0) {
        currentIndex--;
      }
      updateCarousel();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
    if (currentIndex > cards.length - cardsPerView) {
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - cardsPerView);
    }
    buildDots();
    updateCarousel();
  });

  buildDots();
  updateCarousel();

  // ===== STORE LOCATOR =====
  const zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');
  const searchBtn = document.getElementById('storeSearchBtn');
  const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');

  function doStoreSearch() {
    var val = zipInput.value.trim();
    if (val.length > 0) {
      storeResults.classList.add('show');
      storeResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }
  }

  searchBtn.addEventListener('click', doStoreSearch);
  zipInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      doStoreSearch();
    }
  });

  // ===== NEWSLETTER =====
  var newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
  var newsletterConfirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');
  newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    newsletterForm.style.display = 'none';
    newsletterConfirm.classList.add('show');
  });

  // ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
  var animItems = document.querySelectorAll('.animate-on-scroll');
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {
    threshold: 0.1,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px'
  });
  animItems.forEach(function(item) {
    observer.observe(item);
  });

  // Stagger animations for grid children
  document.querySelectorAll('.seasonal-grid .animate-on-scroll, .categories-grid .animate-on-scroll, .stats-grid .animate-on-scroll').forEach(function(item, i) {
    item.style.transitionDelay = (i * 0.1) + 's';
  });

  // ===== KEYBOARD ACCESSIBILITY FOR CATEGORIES =====
  document.querySelectorAll('.category-card').forEach(function(card) {
    card.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        card.click();
      }
    });
  });

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

  right: 20px;
  background: rgba(244, 162, 97, 0.12);
  color: var(--orange-dark);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 100px;
}

/* ===== CATEGORIES ===== */
.categories-section {
  background: var(--white);
}
.categories-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}
.category-card {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  aspect-ratio: 3/4;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.category-card:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}
.category-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 64px;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}
.category-card:hover .category-bg {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}
.category-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 24px;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.category-overlay::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.85), rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.1) 60%, transparent);
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.category-card:hover .category-overlay::before {
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.92), rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.3) 70%, rgba(27, 67, 50, 0.1));
}
.category-name {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: white;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.category-desc {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(10px);
  transition: all 0.35s ease;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.category-card:hover .category-desc {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* ===== BRAND HIGHLIGHTS / STATS ===== */
.stats-section {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 72px 0;
}
.stats-section::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-dark) 0%, var(--green) 50%, var(--green-dark) 100%);
  opacity: 0.9;
}
.stats-pattern {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 24px 24px;
}
.stats-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 40px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.stat-item {
  text-align: center;
}
.stat-number {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 52px);
  color: white;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.stat-number span {
  color: var(--orange-light);
}
.stat-label {
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.stat-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ===== STORE LOCATOR ===== */
.locator-section {
  background: linear-gradient(170deg, #e8f5e9 0%, var(--cream) 100%);
}
.locator-card {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  background: white;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 48px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}
.locator-input-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.locator-input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 16px;
  outline: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  background: var(--cream);
}
.locator-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
}
.locator-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }
.locator-search-btn {
  padding: 16px 32px;
  background: var(--green);
  color: white;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.locator-search-btn:hover {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.locator-search-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

/* Store results */
.store-results {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 24px;
}
.store-results.show { display: block; }
.store-results-title {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.store-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: 1px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  transition: var(--transition);
  background: var(--cream);
}
.store-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}
.store-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 22px;
}
.store-details {
  flex: 1;
}
.store-name {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-dark);
}
.store-address {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.store-hours {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--green);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.store-distance {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--green);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ===== NEWSLETTER ===== */
.newsletter-section {
  background: var(--white);
}
.newsletter-card {
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9 0%, #fff8e1 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 56px 48px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.newsletter-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 20px 20px;
}
.newsletter-emoji {
  font-size: 56px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  position: relative;
}
.newsletter-title {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.newsletter-subtitle {
  position: relative;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  max-width: 440px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.newsletter-form {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  max-width: 440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.newsletter-input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 15px;
  outline: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  background: white;
}
.newsletter-input:focus {
  border-color: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
}
.newsletter-submit {
  padding: 16px 28px;
  background: var(--orange);
  color: white;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.newsletter-submit:hover {
  background: var(--orange-dark);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.newsletter-confirm {
  display: none;
  position: relative;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  background: rgba(45, 106, 79, 0.08);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  color: var(--green);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 15px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.newsletter-confirm.show {
  display: flex;
}

/* ===== FOOTER ===== */
.footer {
  background: var(--green-dark);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  padding: 72px 0 32px;
}
.footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5fr repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}
.footer-brand {
  max-width: 260px;
}
.footer-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 22px;
  color: white;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.footer-logo-icon {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
}
.footer-tagline {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.footer-col-title {
  font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: white;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}
.footer-col a {
  display: block;
  font-size: 14px;
  padding: 5px 0;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.footer-col a:hover {
  color: white;
  transform: translateX(4px);
}
.footer-bottom {
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  padding-top: 28px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.footer-social {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
}
.footer-social-link {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: var(--transition);
  font-size: 16px;
}
.footer-social-link:hover {
  background: var(--orange);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .hero-inner {
    flex-direction: column;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 60px 0;
  }
  .hero-content { max-width: 100%; }
  .hero-subtitle { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
  .hero-ctas { justify-content: center; }
  .hero-image-card { width: 320px; height: 340px; }
  .hero-emoji-grid { font-size: 40px; }
  .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 32px; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .section { padding: 72px 0; }
  .nav-links { display: none; }
  .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; }
  .hero-inner { gap: 40px; padding: 40px 0; }
  .hero-image-card { width: 280px; height: 300px; }
  .hero-float-tag { display: none; }
  .product-card { width: 220px; }
  .product-image { height: 160px; font-size: 56px; }
  .seasonal-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .stats-section { padding: 56px 0; }
  .locator-card { padding: 32px 24px; }
  .locator-input-row { flex-direction: column; }
  .newsletter-card { padding: 40px 24px; }
  .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
  .footer-brand { max-width: 100%; grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; text-align: center; }
  .store-item { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; gap: 12px; }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .container { padding: 0 16px; }
  .section { padding: 56px 0; }
  .hero-image-card { width: 240px; height: 260px; }
  .hero-emoji-grid { font-size: 32px; gap: 14px; }
  .categories-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';

  // ===== HEADER SCROLL =====
  const header = document.getElementById('header');
  let lastScroll = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
    const curr = window.scrollY;
    if (curr > 40) {
      header.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
      header.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
    lastScroll = curr;
  }, { passive: true });

  // ===== MOBILE MENU =====
  const mobileBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
  mobileBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
  });
  mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
    });
  });

  // ===== CAROUSEL =====
  const track = document.getElementById('carouselInner');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.product-card');
  const prevBtn = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
  const nextBtn = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
  const dotsContainer = document.getElementById('carouselDots');

  let currentIndex = 0;
  let cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();

  function getCardsPerView() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w < 480) return 1;
    if (w < 768) return 2;
    if (w < 1024) return 3;
    return 4;
  }

  function getTotalPages() {
    return Math.max(1, cards.length - cardsPerView + 1);
  }

  function buildDots() {
    dotsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const pages = Math.ceil(cards.length / cardsPerView);
    for (let i = 0; i < pages; i++) {
      const dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'carousel-dot' + (i === Math.floor(currentIndex / cardsPerView) ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to page ' + (i + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() {
        currentIndex = i * cardsPerView;
        if (currentIndex > cards.length - cardsPerView) currentIndex = cards.length - cardsPerView;
        updateCarousel();
      });
      dotsContainer.appendChild(dot);
    }
  }

  function updateCarousel() {
    const gap = 24;
    const card = cards[0];
    const cardWidth = card.offsetWidth + gap;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-currentIndex * cardWidth) + 'px)';
    prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex <= 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= cards.length - cardsPerView;
    const pages = Math.ceil(cards.length / cardsPerView);
    const activePage = Math.floor(currentIndex / cardsPerView);
    dotsContainer.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot').forEach(function(d, i) {
      d.classList.toggle('active', i === activePage);
    });
  }

  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      currentIndex--;
      updateCarousel();
    }
  });

  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    if (currentIndex < cards.length - cardsPerView) {
      currentIndex++;
      updateCarousel();
    }
  });

  // Touch/swipe
  let startX = 0;
  let isDragging = false;
  const trackEl = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
  trackEl.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
    startX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    isDragging = true;
  }, { passive: true });
  trackEl.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    isDragging = false;
    const diff = startX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
      if (diff > 0 && currentIndex < cards.length - cardsPerView) {
        currentIndex++;
      } else if (diff < 0 && currentIndex > 0) {
        currentIndex--;
      }
      updateCarousel();
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
    if (currentIndex > cards.length - cardsPerView) {
      currentIndex = Math.max(0, cards.length - cardsPerView);
    }
    buildDots();
    updateCarousel();
  });

  buildDots();
  updateCarousel();

  // ===== STORE LOCATOR =====
  const zipInput = document.getElementById('zipInput');
  const searchBtn = document.getElementById('storeSearchBtn');
  const storeResults = document.getElementById('storeResults');

  function doStoreSearch() {
    var val = zipInput.value.trim();
    if (val.length > 0) {
      storeResults.classList.add('show');
      storeResults.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }
  }

  searchBtn.addEventListener('click', doStoreSearch);
  zipInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      doStoreSearch();
    }
  });

  // ===== NEWSLETTER =====
  var newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
  var newsletterConfirm = document.getElementById('newsletterConfirm');
  newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    newsletterForm.style.display = 'none';
    newsletterConfirm.classList.add('show');
  });

  // ===== SCROLL ANIMATIONS =====
  var animItems = document.querySelectorAll('.animate-on-scroll');
  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
    entries.forEach(function(entry) {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {
    threshold: 0.1,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px'
  });
  animItems.forEach(function(item) {
    observer.observe(item);
  });

  // Stagger animations for grid children
  document.querySelectorAll('.seasonal-grid .animate-on-scroll, .categories-grid .animate-on-scroll, .stats-grid .animate-on-scroll').forEach(function(item, i) {
    item.style.transitionDelay = (i * 0.1) + 's';
  });

  // ===== KEYBOARD ACCESSIBILITY FOR CATEGORIES =====
  document.querySelectorAll('.category-card').forEach(function(card) {
    card.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        card.click();
      }
    });
  });

})();
</script>

steps.message:
The Fresh Pantry landing page is complete at `/app/output/index.html` (56KB, self-contained). Here's what was built:

**Sections delivered** (all 8 required):
- **Header** — sticky with blur backdrop, 4 nav links (Products, Our Stores, Recipes, About Us), mobile hamburger menu
- **Hero** — gradient background with floating organic shapes, animated emoji food grid, 2 CTAs, floating stat tags
- **Featured Products** — horizontal carousel with all 8 products, left/right arrow navigation, dot indicators, swipe support on mobile
- **Seasonal Picks** — 4 cards with hover top-border reveal animation, "Seasonal" badges
- **Categories** — 5 cards with hover scale-up + description overlay reveal
- **Brand Highlights** — dark green banner with dot pattern, 4 stats (500+, 4,000+, 80%, New Items)
- **Store Locator** — zip code input + search button, reveals 3 mock Chicago store results with addresses/hours/distances
- **Newsletter** — email input + subscribe button, shows confirmation message on submit
- **Footer** — 5-column layout (brand + 4 link columns), social icons, copyright
